data.description:
## What
Create tests/scripts/test-translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh defining expected behavior of the recipe→LLM task translation helper.

## Why
TDD RED phase: the translation from recipe spec to natural-language LLM task description is independently testable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- test-translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh exists and is executable
- Tests verify: (a) add-parameter recipe with capability_description 'Add a parameter to a function signature...' → outputs natural-language task description containing the capability description and the recipe params (function name, new param); (b) normalize-imports recipe → outputs description including 'sort and deduplicate' language from capability_description; (c) missing capability_description (empty/absent) → outputs generic fallback description referencing recipe name; (d) recipe_params passed as --param key=value → incorporated into task description as context; (e) --output-format=task-prompt flag → wraps output in task prompt template with ## What / ## Why / ## Acceptance Criteria structure
- RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH env var injectable for test isolation
- All tests FAIL before Task 2 is complete

## File Impact
- CREATE: tests/scripts/test-translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh

## Testing Mode
RED — write failing tests first

## Dependencies
None
data.title: RED: Write failing tests for translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh
